column1: # Persian adjudicated GOLD — hand-verified standard Iranian pronunciations of common words, our convention:
# Perso-Arabic abjad, consonant + long-vowel skeleton (aː uː iː), ʔ-initial, خوا→xʷaː, final ه→e. The short-vowel
# QUALITY (a/e/o) is folded (unrecoverable); these are mostly long-vowel-dominant words where the skeleton IS the answer.
